description: This PHP source file, CustomerMenuConfigurator.php, defines a class that configures menu options for a Customer menu in the OrangeHRM Time plugin module. It implements a menu configuration interface and uses traits for module screen helper functionalities.

classes.name: CustomerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the menu for customer-related screens within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It overrides the default screen to 'viewCustomers'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu by overriding the current screen to 'viewCustomers' and returns null.
